name: tau
description: Code-CAD for coding agents: build replicad, OpenSCAD, JSCAD, Manifold, PicoVoxel, SMLib, tscircuit, build123d, SMLibPy and PicoGK models, check them with GeoSpec tests, screenshot them and export STEP, STL, 3MF or glTF. Needs Node.js 24 and the Tau CLI: npm install -g @taucad/cli@beta.

interface.shortDescription: Code-CAD you can see and test
interface.longDescription: Author parametric CAD in replicad, OpenSCAD, JSCAD, Manifold, PicoVoxel, SMLib, tscircuit, build123d, SMLibPy or PicoGK, then let Tau evaluate it, run its GeoSpec geometry tests, render screenshots and export STEP, STL, 3MF or glTF from your project folder. Needs Node.js 24 and the Tau CLI: npm install -g @taucad/cli@beta.
defaultPrompt: Model a parametric wall bracket in replicad and show me a screenshot.
Run the GeoSpec tests for this Tau project and fix what fails.
Export main.ts as STEP and tell me where the file is.
